survey: An outdoor chess table with two stools on a grass lawn, with a pale path and trees behind. The camera looks down from slightly above and to the front-left. The square tabletop is seen from above, with its front corner pointing toward the viewer. The 8×8 checker pattern sits flat on the top: its rows run parallel to the table edges, and the squares shrink and bunch up toward the back corner. A square pedestal comes straight down from the middle of the top. It meets a wider square base plate whose top face is seen from the same high angle, so its front corner and two side faces match the tabletop. The base sits flat on the grass, and its cast shadow falls back and to the right. Each stool is an upright cylinder with a wider round seat. The seat tops are ellipses whose narrowness suits a level surface seen from slightly above. Each stool's bottom edge curves the same way as its top, and both stools stand flat on the ground with matching shadows. The verticals of the pedestal and the stools stay vertical. The left stool is farther back and drawn smaller, and the right stool is nearer and drawn larger, which matches the ground plane.
